title: Customize Weather on Oasis New Tab Page
description: Learn how to customize the weather widget on Oasis's new tab page, including location settings, temperature units, and display preferences for personalized weather information.
content:
Oasis browser's new tab page includes a convenient weather widget that provides real-time weather information for your location. This feature helps you stay informed about current conditions and forecasts without leaving your browser. You can customize the weather display, set your preferred location, choose temperature units, and control how weather information appears on your new tab page.

Pro Tip

The weather widget on Oasis's new tab page provides quick access to weather information without needing to visit a separate weather website. Customize it to match your preferences and location for the most useful experience.

Accessing Weather Customization

To customize the weather widget on your new tab page:

  1. Open a new tab in Oasis (Ctrl+T or Cmd+T)
  2. Look for the weather widget in the top-right area of the new tab page
  3. Click on the weather widget or the settings icon (⚙️) next to it
  4. Select "Customize" or "Settings" to access weather preferences

Alternatively, you can access weather settings through Oasis preferences:

  1. Open Oasis Settings (Menu → Settings)
  2. Navigate to the "Home" or "New Tab" section
  3. Find the "Weather" or "New Tab Page" settings
  4. Click "Customize" to modify weather preferences

Weather Widget Features

Current Weather Display

Basic weather information shown on the new tab page:

  • Temperature: Current temperature in your preferred units
  • Weather Condition: Sunny, cloudy, rainy, etc. with appropriate icons
  • Location: City name and country
  • Time: Last updated timestamp

Detailed Weather Information

Additional weather details available:

  • Humidity: Current humidity percentage
  • Wind Speed: Wind speed and direction
  • Feels Like: Apparent temperature considering wind and humidity
  • UV Index: Sun protection recommendations

Forecast Information

Extended weather predictions:

  • Hourly Forecast: Weather predictions for the next 24 hours
  • Daily Forecast: 5-7 day weather outlook
  • Precipitation Chance: Probability of rain or snow
  • Temperature Range: High and low temperatures

Weather Alerts

Important weather notifications:

  • Severe Weather: Warnings for storms, extreme temperatures
  • Air Quality: Air quality index and health recommendations
  • Pollen Count: Allergy information for sensitive users
  • Weather Advisories: Official weather service alerts

Location Settings

Setting Your Location

Configure your weather location:

  • Automatic Detection: Let Oasis detect your location automatically
  • Manual Entry: Enter your city name or ZIP code manually
  • GPS Location: Use your device's GPS for precise location
  • IP-based Location: Use your IP address to determine location

Privacy Note: Location access requires your permission. You can revoke location access at any time in your browser settings.

Multiple Locations

Manage weather for multiple locations:

  • Add Locations: Save weather information for multiple cities
  • Location Switching: Easily switch between saved locations
  • Default Location: Set your primary location for quick access
  • Location Management: Add, edit, or remove saved locations

Location Accuracy

Ensure accurate weather information:

  • Precise Location: Use exact coordinates for most accurate weather
  • City-level Accuracy: Acceptable for general weather information
  • Location Updates: Automatically update location when you travel
  • Manual Refresh: Manually refresh location data when needed

Display Customization

Temperature Units

Choose your preferred temperature display:

  • Celsius (°C): International standard temperature unit
  • Fahrenheit (°F): Common in the United States
  • Kelvin (K): Scientific temperature scale
  • Auto-detect: Automatically use units based on your location

Widget Size and Position

Customize the weather widget appearance:

  • Widget Size: Choose between compact, normal, or large display
  • Position: Move the widget to different areas of the new tab page
  • Visibility: Show or hide the weather widget entirely
  • Transparency: Adjust widget transparency for aesthetic preferences

Information Display

Control what weather information is shown:

  • Basic Info: Show only temperature and condition
  • Detailed Info: Include humidity, wind, and other details
  • Forecast: Display hourly or daily forecasts
  • Alerts: Show weather warnings and advisories

Weather Data Sources

Data Providers

Oasis uses reliable weather data sources:

  • AccuWeather: Comprehensive weather data and forecasts
  • Weather.com: The Weather Channel's weather information
  • National Weather Service: Official US weather data
  • Local Weather Services: Regional weather information providers

Data Updates

How often weather information is refreshed:

  • Real-time Updates: Current conditions updated every 15-30 minutes
  • Forecast Updates: Daily forecasts updated multiple times per day
  • Alert Updates: Weather alerts updated immediately when issued
  • Manual Refresh: Option to manually refresh weather data

Data Accuracy

Ensuring reliable weather information:

  • Multiple Sources: Cross-reference data from multiple providers
  • Quality Control: Verify data accuracy and consistency
  • Error Handling: Graceful handling of data errors or outages
  • Fallback Options: Alternative data sources when primary sources fail

Privacy and Data Usage

Location Privacy

How your location data is handled:

  • Local Storage: Location preferences stored locally on your device
  • Encrypted Transmission: Location data encrypted when sent to weather services
  • No Tracking: Location data not used for tracking or advertising
  • User Control: You control when and how location is shared

Data Collection

What data is collected for weather services:

  • Location Data: Your city or coordinates for weather information
  • Usage Analytics: How you interact with weather features (anonymized)
  • Error Reports: Technical issues with weather functionality
  • Performance Data: Weather widget loading times and reliability
Privacy Note

Oasis's weather feature is designed with privacy in mind. Location data is only used to provide weather information and is not shared with third parties for advertising or tracking purposes. You can disable location access at any time.

Troubleshooting Weather Issues

Common Weather Problems

Issues you might encounter with the weather widget:

  • Location Not Found: Weather widget can't determine your location
  • Outdated Information: Weather data appears stale or incorrect
  • Widget Not Loading: Weather widget fails to display
  • Incorrect Units: Temperature or other units display incorrectly

Solutions and Fixes

How to resolve weather widget issues:

  1. Check Location Permissions: Ensure Oasis has permission to access your location
  2. Refresh Weather Data: Manually refresh the weather widget
  3. Clear Browser Cache: Clear cached data that might be causing issues
  4. Check Internet Connection: Ensure you have a stable internet connection
  5. Update Oasis: Make sure you're using the latest version of Oasis
  6. Reset Weather Settings: Reset weather preferences to default values

Alternative Weather Sources

If the built-in weather widget isn't working:

  • Weather Websites: Visit weather.com, accuweather.com, or other weather sites
  • Weather Extensions: Install weather extensions from the add-on store
  • System Weather Apps: Use your operating system's weather application
  • Mobile Weather Apps: Use weather apps on your mobile device

Advanced Weather Features

Weather Notifications

Set up weather alerts and notifications:

  • Severe Weather Alerts: Get notified of storms, extreme temperatures, etc.
  • Daily Weather Summary: Receive daily weather updates
  • Precipitation Alerts: Get notified when rain or snow is expected
  • Temperature Alerts: Set temperature thresholds for notifications

Weather Integration

Connect weather with other Oasis features:

  • Calendar Integration: Weather information for scheduled events
  • Travel Planning: Weather forecasts for travel destinations
  • Outdoor Activity Planning: Weather conditions for outdoor activities
  • Clothing Recommendations: Weather-based clothing suggestions

Weather History

Access historical weather data:

  • Past Weather: View weather conditions from previous days
  • Weather Trends: Analyze weather patterns over time
  • Seasonal Comparisons: Compare current weather to historical averages
  • Weather Records: View record temperatures and weather events

Additional Resources

For more information about weather features and customization, we recommend:

Mozilla New Tab Page Customization Guide - Official guide from Mozilla

Firefox New Tab Page Settings - Detailed customization options

Firefox Weather Widget Documentation - Weather feature information

Important Disclaimer

This guide discusses Oasis's weather customization features. The weather widget and customization options described are specific to Oasis's approach. Other browsers may have different weather features, customization options, and data sources. Weather information is provided by third-party services and may not always be 100% accurate.

Note: Oasis has a version derived from Firefox core, which is why it shares similar new tab page customization features and can benefit from Mozilla's weather integration capabilities.
